Equipping professionals with the power of resilience, empathy, and innovative decision-making skills through training, community wellness classes and networking.

What we do
The Integrate Trauma Informed Network, founded by Julie Johnson and human care experts, empowers NGOs, coaches, and care providers to create supportive, more empathetic professional spaces. By amplifying resilience strategies and compassion-focused practices, it promotes trauma-informed care to reduce harm and strengthen interpersonal connections. Join this affinity group and transform care practices with tools designed for wellness, education, and business growth.

DOWNLOAD OUR "Let's Integrate" app (lets integrate) on the Google Play and App Store.

“Lead with compassion, act with conviction and invite change as a shared reality.”
